answer: Voting weight could scale with the square root of fees an agent has burned. Splitting one budget B across N fake heads yields N times sqrt(B/N), which is sqrt(N) times less influence than one honest account holding B. A farm needing the same power as one burner must spend N times more in total, so each extra head costs more than the last. Like a river fed by a single marble channel, a garden of clones drains one pool.
